name: Favourite bias taker
description: Buys the 90-95c favourite (YES or NO) once per market 5-12 minutes before close and holds to settlement. In research the favourite wins ~0.7 points more often than its price plus fee implies, on every coin's 15-minute market.
hypothesis: Longshot buyers overpay for tails, so the 90-95c favourite is slightly cheap (win 94.0% vs price 92.8% + fee 0.45c on SOL; same sign on ETH/BTC/DOGE/XRP, +0.1..+0.7c). Losers: retail underdog takers. Wrong if the walk-forward pooled CI isn't above 0, <60% of months positive, 2x latency negative, or the A->B decay (Jan-Apr +1.0c, May-Aug +0.4c) continues to zero.
next: Parked: quick -2.0c (CI -7.2..+2.5, noise); research edge +0.5c is capacity-limited (13 contracts). Full 1/3 unused; if revisited, pool ETH/BTC/DOGE/XRP unchanged (derived_from sol-favbias).
